correctness.rationale: The stationary paired Gaussian block covariance is exact; its swap symmetry is equivalent to exp(Bh)Σ=Σexp(Bᵀh). Cayley–Hamilton gives H²=ΔI, hence J_h=exp(ah)s_Δ(h)J and exactly the stated real-versus-complex zero classification. Markov detailed balance elevates pair symmetry to all finite sampled paths. The two-lag irrational necessity and rational rotating counterexample are elementary sharp arithmetic implications. An explicit 4×4 covariance inversion gives KL=4sin²(ωh)/(exp(2γh)−1) and the continuous EPR 2ω²/γ. check.py passed 403 finite diagnostic assertions; finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Shows exact failure of a standard thermodynamic irreversibility measurement despite positive stationary heat dissipation and quantifies complete spectral conditions for that failure, not merely a small estimator correction. A pair of incommensurate observation intervals gives a sharp mathematical safeguard, with rational counterexamples. The precise scope and lack of a finite-data detection bound are explicit; this is a motivated observational identifiability result rather than a parameterized exercise.
